scope: Bounded read-only historical identity/variant audit; no registry or operative mutation, no raw tables.

decision.reason: GDT636 and GDT754 overlap on a fraction-II/part core, so the propositions are not unrelated. They remain separate addressable historical variants because GDT636 declares a compositional four-head field reading, while GDT754 audits an older exact-whole PRODUCTIVE_COMPOUND default (“second drug fraction”) and then withdraws its literal drug prose, retaining only an open fraction/part field. Source scope and claim level differ; identity should remain unresolved rather than forced.
decision.identity_limit: No claim that the forms have different manuscript meanings; only that the recorded historical propositions are not safely identical.
decision.reopen: An independently source-bound whole-form role that explicitly bridges the shared fraction-II core to the same complete air card could support a later identity review.

patch_check.finding: GDT754 reports stronger local occurrence readings for lkaiin; GDT738 explicitly says discovery forms including lky produce no renderer patch. Do not generalize the 42-cell local patch family to air or lky.
patch_check.scope: The cited GDT754 air row retains “Index/Stufe II und Teil-/Fraktionsfeld; genaue Ganzform offen”; it does not reinstate “Droge.”
